title: Initial/boundary value problems for integrable systems
exact_target: Determine the long-time response of half-line NLS to boundary driving and overcome the unknown Neumann-trace obstacle.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000014 (AMR-079-0014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 14.

status_qualification: The example retains every smooth compactly supported initial profile and the prescribed sinusoidal boundary driver with nonzero frequency. Compatibility at the initial-boundary corner must be addressed where a classical solution is sought; it is not silently removed.
